releaseNotes:
ReVa v6.0.0.1 - Major Release & Next-Gen AI Financial Core!

✨ New Features & Improvements:
• Physical Cash Change Register: Track tendered notes & exact change received back
• Direct Google Gemini AI Integration (Gemini 2.5 Flash, 2.0 Flash, 2.5 Pro) with smart fallback
• ReVa AI Interactive Advisor with real-time net-worth and balance context
• Natural Language Quick Transaction Log ("Paid 500 for lunch, got 380 back")
• AI "Can I Afford This?" Purchase Simulator
• AI Deep Expense Leak & Financial Health Scorecards
• Standardized expense and income categories across the entire system
• Modern emerald fintech UI/UX with glassmorphic cards and unified headers
